mapper.sql: select e.enroll_id, e.round_id, e.student_id, e.course_offering_id, e.select_time, e.lottery_result, e.result_status, e.waitlist_rank, e.drop_time, e.status, e.del_flag, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, ss.student_no as student_code, ss.student_name as student_name, cl.course_name as course_name, r.round_name as round_name from tpm_selection_enrollment e left join sam_student ss on e.student_id = ss.student_id left join tpm_course_offering o on e.course_offering_id = o.offering_id left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join tpm_selection_round r on e.round_id = r.round_id
mapper.insert:
insert into tpm_selection_enrollment
round_id, student_id, course_offering_id, select_time, lottery_result, result_status, drop_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag,
#{roundId}, #{studentId}, #{courseOfferingId}, #{selectTime}, #{lotteryResult}, #{resultStatus}, #{dropTime}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark}, '0',
mapper.update: update tpm_selection_enrollment set del_flag = '2' where enroll_id = #{enrollId}
update tpm_selection_enrollment set del_flag = '2' where enroll_id in #{enrollId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from tpm_selection_enrollment where course_offering_id = #{courseOfferingId} and result_status != '3' and del_flag = '0'

select count(distinct o.course_id) from tpm_selection_enrollment e left join tpm_course_offering o on e.course_offering_id = o.offering_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.result_status = '1' and e.del_flag = '0' and o.course_id in #{courseId}
where e.course_offering_id = #{courseOfferingId} and e.lottery_result = '2' and e.result_status = '2' and e.waitlist_rank is not null and e.del_flag = '0' order by e.waitlist_rank asc
select count(1) from tpm_selection_enrollment where course_offering_id = #{courseOfferingId} and lottery_result = '1' and result_status = '1' and del_flag = '0'
